purpose: Canonical inventory of Yggdrasil applications, components, builds, installations, signing identity, and verification evidence.

status_vocabulary.planned: Intended but no implementation evidence recorded.
status_vocabulary.built: A build artifact or source implementation exists; installation is not implied.
status_vocabulary.user_reported_installed: The user reports installation; device-side verification has not yet confirmed it.
status_vocabulary.device_verified_installed: A device-side observation confirms the installed package and version at the recorded time.
status_vocabulary.unverified: Evidence is insufficient to assign a stronger status.

verification_rules: Never infer installation from a successful build or artifact download.
Keep user-reported installation distinct from device-verified installation.
Record package ID, version, source commit, artifact SHA-256, and signer SHA-256 independently.
A build-time signing fingerprint does not establish the signer of an installed package.
Unknown values remain null or explicitly unknown; do not fill them by inference.
Record evidence source and observation time for every status change.

devices.notes: Device model and Android version are available from session context; installed package inventory has not been independently read from the device.
